task_title: Test Note App Delete and Star Functionality

context.description: We are testing a note-taking app that recently had delete and star functionality added. The backend API endpoints are confirmed working via direct API tests, but we need to verify the frontend buttons are properly wired up and the UI updates correctly.
recent_changes: Added delete and star buttons to NoteCard component (frontend)
Added enhanced console logging with emojis for debugging

known_facts.backend_tested: Both DELETE and PUT /star endpoints work correctly via direct API calls
known_facts.frontend_updated: Enhanced logging added to handleStarNote and handleDeleteNote functions

services_check.action: Run health check to ensure all services are running
services_check.expected_output: All three services (Frontend, Backend, PostgreSQL) should show [OK] Running

test_scenarios.name: Visual Verification - Buttons Appear on Hover

steps.playwright_command: await page.goto('http://localhost:3000')

steps.action: Wait for page to fully load
steps.playwright_command: await page.waitForTimeout(3000)
const noteCards = await page.$$('article.note-card'); console.log('Found', noteCards.length, 'note cards')
steps.expected: Should see multiple note cards (up to 559)

steps.action: Hover over the first note card
steps.playwright_command: await noteCards[0].hover()
steps.expected: Action buttons should fade in with opacity-0 to opacity-100 transition

steps.action: Verify star button exists and is visible
steps.playwright_command: const starButton = await noteCards[0].$('button[title*="Star"]'); console.log('Star button found:', !!starButton)

steps.action: Verify delete button exists and is visible
steps.playwright_command: const deleteButton = await noteCards[0].$('button[title*="Delete"]'); console.log('Delete button found:', !!deleteButton)

test_scenarios.success_criteria: Both star and delete buttons appear when hovering over note cards

steps.action: Open browser console to monitor network and logs
steps.details: Press F12 or use Playwright's console event listener

steps.playwright_command: page.on('console', msg => console.log('BROWSER LOG:', msg.type(), msg.text()))
page.on('request', req => { if (req.url().includes('/star')) console.log('REQUEST:', req.method(), req.url()) })
page.on('response', res => { if (res.url().includes('/star')) console.log('RESPONSE:', res.status(), res.url()) })

steps.action: Get the first note card and record its initial state
steps.playwright_command: const firstCard = await page.$('article.note-card'); const initialStarState = await firstCard.$('svg.fill-current')
steps.details: Check if the star is already filled (is_starred: true) or empty (is_starred: false)

steps.playwright_command: await firstCard.hover(); await page.waitForTimeout(500)
const starBtn = await firstCard.$('button[title*="Star"]'); await starBtn.click()
expected_console_logs: ✅ Updated note: [note object with toggled is_starred]

steps.playwright_command: await page.waitForTimeout(1000)

steps.details: Check if the star SVG now has fill-current class (filled) or just stroke (empty) - opposite of initial state

steps.action: Click star button again to toggle back
steps.playwright_command: await starBtn.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
steps.expected: Star should return to original state

success_criteria.console_logs_present: All expected emoji logs (🌟, 📡, 📨, ✅) appear in console
success_criteria.network_request_made: PUT request to /api/notes/:id/star is visible in network tab
success_criteria.ui_updates: Star icon visually toggles between filled and empty states
success_criteria.state_persists: Refreshing the page shows the updated star state

failure_indicators.no_console_logs: Click event not firing - JavaScript error or event handler not attached
failure_indicators.network_error: CORS issue, backend down, or incorrect URL
failure_indicators.ui_not_updating: State management issue - response successful but UI not re-rendering

steps.action: Record total number of notes before deletion
steps.playwright_command: const initialCount = (await page.$$('article.note-card')).length; console.log('Initial note count:', initialCount)

steps.action: Set up console and network listeners (same as star test)
steps.details: Listen for 🗑️ emoji logs and DELETE requests

steps.action: Get the last note card (to avoid losing important notes)
steps.playwright_command: const allCards = await page.$$('article.note-card'); const lastCard = allCards[allCards.length - 1]

steps.action: Hover over the last note card
steps.playwright_command: await lastCard.hover(); await page.waitForTimeout(500)
const deleteBtn = await lastCard.$('button[title*="Delete"]'); await deleteBtn.click()
steps.note: This will trigger a browser confirm() dialog

steps.playwright_command: page.on('dialog', dialog => { console.log('Dialog message:', dialog.message()); dialog.accept(); })
steps.details: Accept the 'Are you sure you want to delete this note?' confirmation

steps.playwright_command: await page.waitForTimeout(2000)
const finalCount = (await page.$$('article.note-card')).length; console.log('Final note count:', finalCount)

steps.action: Refresh page to verify deletion persisted
steps.playwright_command: await page.reload(); await page.waitForTimeout(3000); const afterReloadCount = (await page.$$('article.note-card')).length
steps.expected: afterReloadCount should equal finalCount (deletion persisted to database)

success_criteria.confirmation_dialog_appears: Browser confirm() dialog shows with message
success_criteria.response_status_ok: Backend responds with 204 No Content or 200 OK
success_criteria.ui_updates: Note card disappears from grid immediately
success_criteria.deletion_persists: After page refresh, note is still gone

failure_indicators.no_dialog: Delete button click not triggering handleDeleteNote function
failure_indicators.dialog_dismissed: If dialog is cancelled, no deletion should occur
failure_indicators.no_console_logs: Click event or dialog handling issue
failure_indicators.ui_not_updating: Note remains visible despite successful API call

test_scenarios.name: Backend API Direct Verification
test_scenarios.purpose: Verify backend endpoints work independently of frontend

steps.action: Get list of notes and pick one to test
steps.expected: JSON array of 5 notes with all properties including id, is_starred
Returns updated note with is_starred toggled

steps.note: This will return 405 Method Not Allowed (GET single note not implemented), but that's expected

steps.expected: Empty response (204 No Content) indicating success
Should not find the deleted note ID in the results

if_buttons_not_visible: Check if note cards are rendering at all
Hover is working (cursor changes, scale animation happens)
Inspect element to see if buttons exist in DOM with opacity-0
Check for CSS conflicts or z-index issues
if_clicks_do_nothing: Open browser console and check for JavaScript errors
Verify event handlers are attached (check React DevTools)
Check if e.stopPropagation() is preventing clicks
Look for onClick vs onPointerDown conflicts
if_network_requests_not_firing: Console shows logs but no network activity = fetch() blocked or CORS
Check browser network tab for failed requests
Verify backend is running on port 8080
Check for mixed content warnings (http vs https)
if_backend_returns_errors: Check backend terminal logs for error details
Check if note IDs are valid UUIDs
Look for SQL errors or constraint violations
if_ui_doesnt_update: API succeeds but UI unchanged = state management issue
Check if setNotes() is being called
Verify the notes array is being modified correctly
Look for stale closures or race conditions

include: All console log output (copy exact text)
Screenshots or descriptions of UI state changes
Any error messages or unexpected behavior
Overall assessment: Are delete and star features working?
Root cause analysis for any failures

success_definition: Both star and delete functionality work end-to-end: buttons appear on hover, clicking triggers correct API calls, backend responds successfully, UI updates immediately, and changes persist after page refresh.
playwright_script_template: See C:\dev\note-app\test-buttons.js for a starting template, but modify to include all test scenarios above
